issues.description: Heuristic getCategoryLabel silently mislabels real category IDs the old map handled correctly.
issues.detail: The old adapter had an explicit map: 'forensics-ready' -> 'Forensics Ready', 'trustboundaries' -> 'Trust Boundaries', 'e3' -> 'E3', 'e5' -> 'E5'. The new heuristic gives 'Trustboundaries' (one word, len>3 so not all-caps, no hyphen to split) and 'e3'/'e5' become 'E3'/'E5' only because len<=3. Lose one assumption and labels regress. Bad taste: replaced a working table with clever rules that already fail on real input.

issues.description: THREE-PATCHES: rename 'Threat Score' -> 'Prowler ThreatScore' is unrelated to Risk Radar.
issues.detail: The PR title says 'add Risk Radar component with category filtering'. The diff also renames terminology across risk-plot-client.tsx and threat-score.tsx. That is a separate concern with separate review surface (copy, i18n, consistency with backend strings). Split it. A diff that does three things is three diffs.

issues.description: SEVERITY_ORDER gains a duplicate-value 'Info' key with no explanation.
issues.detail: Adding Info: 4 alongside Informational: 4 papers over an upstream inconsistency without naming it. Either the API returns 'Info' or it doesn't. If it does, document why and normalize at the boundary; don't quietly accept both spellings in a shared constant. This is exactly how 'special case that should be general' rots a codebase.

issues.description: horizontal-bar-chart recomputes maxValue inside the map loop.
issues.detail: Math.max(...data.map(...)) now runs once per item instead of once per render. Hoist it above the .map. Minor, but the previous inline version had the same bug and you touched the exact lines. Fix it while you are here.

issues.description: CategorySelector reserved value 'all' collides with any future category id literally named 'all'.
issues.detail: handleValueChange treats '' or 'all' as the clear-selection sentinel. Categories come from the API. If the backend ever ships a category id 'all', selecting it clears state instead of selecting it. Use a non-colliding sentinel or a separate clear control.

issues.description: Removing 'category__in' from DEFAULT_FILTER_BADGES loses the active-badge for the new category filter.
issues.detail: You added the Category filter to findings but deleted its entry from DEFAULT_FILTER_BADGES with no replacement. Either the generic path now handles it (state that) or active filter badges silently stop rendering for Category. Confirm and add a test, or restore the entry.

review.summary: NEEDS-WORK. The radar component itself is fine; the surrounding patch is doing three things and one of them regresses behavior. Replacing an explicit category-label table with a heuristic is bad taste — the old table got 'Forensics Ready' and 'Trust Boundaries' right, the new code gets them wrong. The 'Threat Score' -> 'Prowler ThreatScore' rename is unrelated and belongs in its own patch. The duplicate Informational/Info enum value is a band-aid over an API inconsistency that should be normalized at the boundary. Split the patches, restore the explicit label map (or extend it instead of replacing it), and resubmit.
